title: Neuropixels AP and LFP voltage
subject: MFD_09
citation: International Brain Laboratory. Brain-Wide Map public release. Mouse MFD_09, Churchland lab at UCLA, 2023-10-19, probe00.
sourceVersion: Immutable UUID-bearing IBL S3 object keys; original 2023-12-19 upload; file SHA256 hashes recorded below.
processing: Lossless zlib/mtscomp decompression of chunk index 100 using the released compression header.
Retain channels 200–207 (zero-based raw acquisition indices); remove all other channels including the digital synchronization channel.
Convert original signed ADC counts to microvolts using imAiRangeMax/imMaxInt/gain from the acquisition .meta file.
AP: first 7500 samples of chunk 100. LFP: first 2500 samples of chunk 100. No resampling, smoothing, detrending, re-referencing, spike sorting or added filtering.
AP/LFP bands have acquisition hardware filtering; raw means no additional offline processing here.
limitations: Eight preselected adjacent channels from one mouse session, not representative of all recordings.
AP/LFP excerpts use the probe clock. They are not time synchronized to the existing trial-aligned spike raster or to behavioral events.
Local positions are released acquisition-channel coordinates, not anatomical coordinates and not contact IDs of the separate 960-site 3D illustration.
Raw acquisition signals include noise and artifacts; visible transients are not certified single-neuron spikes.
coordinateSystem: IBL channels.localCoordinates in µm; use source rawInd to associate coordinates with raw acquisition indices. No absolute tip offset inferred.
